title: A duplicated batch request
stimulus: A document-export service accepts a client operation token and may crash between storing an export and acknowledging it. Design the token semantics for a retry with identical versus changed parameters, including concurrent duplicate requests.
structural_context: Concurrent duplicate requests plus request-identity contract.

hints.content: Identify the precise assertion you need to justify before proposing a solution.
Look for a change in assumptions that would make your proposed reasoning fail.

validation.reason: Synthetic design fixture; requires answer-key and source review before real assessment use.
